agent.busy: The Agent is still working on the last message. Send this when it's done
agent.provider_unknown: That Provider or model isn't on this Machine
agent.unavailable: The Agent couldn't take this right now. Try again in a moment
agent.unknown: This Machine doesn't have that Agent
egress.invalid_domain: The Machine kept its Egress: one entry isn't a plain domain name
hub.machine_offline: That Machine is offline, so it did not get this
hub.machine_taken: That Machine already belongs to another Workspace. Run veeloe unpair on it, then pair again
hub.pairing_invalid: The Hub refused this link because the signatures did not check out or it has expired. Run veeloe pair again
hub.route_not_allowed: The Hub refused where this was going
hub.sender_mismatch: The Hub refused this because the sender did not match
pairing.hub_unreachable: Couldn't reach the Hub in this link. Check its address and your connection
pairing.link_bad_signature: This link was changed after the Machine made it, so it can't be used
pairing.link_expired: This link has expired. Run veeloe pair on the Machine again
pairing.link_malformed: That isn't a Pairing link. Copy the whole link veeloe pair shows
pairing.timed_out: The Machine didn't answer in time. Check veeloe pair is still running, then try again
provider.failed: The Provider answered with an error
provider.missing: The Agent's Provider was removed from the Machine. Add it again with veeloe provider add
provider.rejected: The Provider refused the key on the Machine
provider.unreachable: The Machine couldn't reach the Provider
task.not_found: This Machine doesn't have that Task
turn.too_many_rounds: The Agent stopped after too many steps in one go
